label.es: Pasaje: el texto de un versículo o rango con sus notas, preguntas y enlaces de palabras

passage.description: The texts of a verse range with the notes, questions and word links in range.

ref.description: A book code and a range, such as "tit 1:1-2".

label.es: Concepto: qué es, sus nombres, sus relaciones y los libros donde aparece

concept.description: A concept of the translation helps with its names and relations, and the installed books that use it.

id.description: A concept id such as "ta:translate/figs-metaphor" or "tw:kt/grace".

label.es: Artículo: las secciones de un artículo de tA o tW

article.description: The default sections of a translation academy or translation words article, or the ones asked for.

section.description: A section id, or "all" for every section.

label.es: Traducciones: cómo se vierte una palabra del original en los libros instalados

renderings.description: How the installed texts render the original words with one Strong number, with counts and references.

word.description: The position of a word in the original of the book.

label.es: Búsqueda: texto en los recursos instalados

search.description: A full-text search over the installed resources.

limit.description: The most results to return (20 when absent).

label.es: Temas: personas, lugares, eventos y más, por categoría o por libro

topics.description: The topics of a category or of a book, or the categories with their counts; installed is false without the topics module.

label.es: Libros: dónde se usa un artículo o concepto, y si el libro está instalado

books.description: For each book, how often an article or concept is used there (or that the source does not cover it) and whether the book is installed.

article.description: A tA or tW article id ("ta:...", "tw:...").

label.es: Contexto: un pasaje con los artículos que sus notas y enlaces nombran

context.description: A passage together with the default sections of the articles its notes and word links name.

ref.description: A book code and a range, such as "tit 1:1-2".
